# New mining token rewards (Event: Danger of Collapse)

![New Mining Tokens Rewards (Event: Danger of Collapse)](/uploads/666_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

For a long time it wasn't worth picking up the mining tokens from the Event: Danger of Collapse. On the contrary: for a long time it even made sense to throw them away because they were heavy and couldn't bring in any interesting rewards. That's changing now.

The mining tokens have not had any weight for some time, but from this update you will also receive interesting rewards for redeeming the mining tokens.

### 10 mining tokens: reward at the terminal

- 15% chance of getting Chems
(Berries Mentats, various Mentats, various Psycho, Fury, Overdrive, Stimpak etc.)
- 15% chance of Contextual Ammo or Random Ammo
- cement, lead, steel
- **10% chance** of any**3* weapon, armor or power armor**

### 20 mining tokens: reward at the terminal

- 15% chance of getting Chems
(Berries Mentats, various Mentats, various Psycho, Fury, Overdrive, Stimpak etc.)
- 45% chance of Contextual Ammo or Random Ammo
- Cement, lead, steel, aluminum
- **25% chance** of any**3* weapon, armor or power armor**

### 40 mining tokens: reward at the terminal

- 60% chance of Chems 
(Berries Mentats, various Mentats, various Psycho, Fury, Overdrive, Stimpak etc.)
- 60% chance of Contextual Ammo or Random Ammo
- Cement, Lead, Steel, Aluminum, Black Titanium
- **50% chance** of any**3* weapon, armor or power armor**

### 100 Mining Tokens: Reward at the terminal

- 100% chance of getting Chems 
(Berries Mentats, various Mentats, various Psycho, Fury, Overdrive, Stimpak etc.)
- 100% chance of Contextual Ammo or Random Ammo
- Cement, Lead, Steel, Aluminum, Black Titanium, Gold
- **3* Metal Armor Chest Piece: Waywarder** - The Hunter
 - Perception
 - Thru Hikers
 - 50% bonus damage for thrown weapons
 - This bonus applies to Throwing Knife, Tomahawk, Sheepsquatch Shard and Meat Cleaver.
- **100% chance** of any**3* weapon, armor or power armor**

![Wegewart Armor](/uploads/nukaknights-post-unique-armor-patch66-trail-warden.jpg)
